issues.description: The EDGAR notebook restricts the scraper and combine loops to one 100-row batch, so it is a demo subset rather than evidence of full filing-list coverage.

The published CSV contains document-level scores, while the authored final-data Rmd reads separate dated full-sample/S-1 RDS files and joins by main item/stickiness/id/GVKEY/date or S-1 filename. Exact replacement mapping is unresolved.

The overlap script reads a GPT-3.5-labelled combined pickle; the API script comments a writer for a differently named generic pickle and then reads that generic file. Exact producer/model/sample mapping is unresolved.
The assembler reads GPT-4o and Gemini overlap RDS files, but the visible overlap producer handles GPT-3.5 and writes CSV/pickle. Matching GPT-4o/Gemini producers remain unresolved.
The GPT-3.5 overlap producer writes CSV/pickle while R expects RDS at a different configured root; convert and stage the data for the actual consumer.
Byte-only comparisons show distinct literal roots for scoring producers/combiner and validation producer/consumer layouts. Configure portable roots and preserve suffix-specific handoffs.
The R assembler creates a GenScore-based consolidated file, while Part II expects named model/stickiness probability fields. The intended field mapping is not established.
Seven local table checks confirm one-row readability and fields but not historical coverage or equivalence to dated author-prepared RDS/query outputs.
IR, institutional ownership, IBES, SDC M&A, segments, and return-decile/control products are dated author inputs whose availability and full 2010–2024 joins are unverified.
GPTZero scoring and ChatGPT batch validation need external model/service outputs and account configuration. No authentication, API, model, or service trial was performed.
FinBERT weights/tokenizer and NLTK tokenizer, stopword, and WordNet resources are unverified.
All 94 registered edges are classified, but data routes, model outputs, root/suffix handoffs, and Part II field mappings remain unresolved; full execution closure is incomplete.

Map local table candidates to author-prepared RDS/query outputs.

Compare the native table fields and periods to the dated author RDS products.
validation: Record full date coverage and verify join-key completeness before building analysis panels.

Confirm every Part II probability field against the R consolidated dataset.

steps: Resolve compatible versions for selenium, webdriver-manager, pikepdf, wrds, transformers, gensim, seaborn, and wordcloud.
Record the environment without running author code or external services.
validation: Confirm source-imported distribution metadata before author workflow execution.

validation: Confirm all required namespaces resolve in the selected R environment.

Native SAS7BDAT checks were one-row Python ReadStat field/readability probes only; they do not establish full history or equivalence to author RDS/query outputs.
No author code, API/authentication trial, model trial, data deserialization, download, install, or SAS command was performed in this assessment.
The EDGAR sample limit, model service outputs, private data routes, model resources, roots/suffixes, and Part II aliases remain explicit prerequisites.
